name: Marigold's Mannequin
source:
Perpetually tired and stuck in a dead-end job, Mari wishes her life could be better. One day, her mannequin comes to life as an exact copy of her. 

Except she gets a more interesting, better-paying job, and slowly fulfills all the dreams Mari never dared to reach for.

[From [url=https://cygni.itch.io/marigolds-mannequin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛丽总是感到疲倦，并陷入了没有出路的工作，她希望自己的生活能够变得更好。有一天，她的人体模型变成了她的一模一样的复制品。

除了她找到了一份更有趣、薪水更高的工作，并慢慢实现了玛丽从未敢于实现的所有梦想。

[来自[url=https://cygni.itch.io/marigolds-mannequin]itch.io[/url]]
